verdict.rationale: Steel's docs describe a debug URL feature for human-in-the-loop workflows in which users can directly interact with and control live browser sessions. There is a dedicated 'Implement Human-in-the-Loop Controls' page and an 'Embed Sessions' page. Together these cover the core of watching a session and taking human control. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live-view streaming quality and of the mid-run handoff mechanics (pausing the agent and returning control to it), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
